overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Committee properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss a federal letter, because litigation was demonstrably likely under the settlement agreements.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee convened in executive session on March 25 to discuss litigation strategy without a proper purpose under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing the March 2 letter in an executive session convened pursuant to Purpose 3.
